kampaniyalar.passportLead: Every masterclass = 1 stamp. 5 stamps = 1 free masterclass.
kampaniyalar.passportNote: Why both? Your stamps are tied to your phone number — so no one else can open your passport, we also ask for a booking reference to confirm it's you.
kampaniyalar.bookingRefHint: This is the TICKET number from your booking confirmation page (e.g. ABCD-1234) — the same number is in your WhatsApp message.
kampaniyalar.referralLead: Your friend gets a discount on their first masterclass, you get one on your next.

kampaniyalar.seasonalLead: In November and December we're planning special New Year-themed workshops and group events. Get in touch for dates and details.

mexfilik.title: Privacy policy
mexfilik.intro: This is a SAMPLE privacy policy — it should be reviewed by a lawyer before real use.

sections.p: The parent's name and phone, the child's name and age, an optional allergy note. No data is collected directly from the child.
Only to make a booking, confirm your spot, and stay in touch via WhatsApp.
Only studio staff. Not shared with third parties (except where legally required).
You may request deletion of your data at any time — message us on WhatsApp or email.
